revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot in template style: webtoon-shot-v1. Canvas 1536x3072 pixels, preserve a 1:2 tall composite canvas with exactly 2 equal-height full-width mini-panels stacked vertically, separated by a clean thin white gutter. Keep 5% safe margin. Read top-to-bottom as one continuous emotional transition, not duplicate variants.

Use Image 1 only as character identity reference for Theo: a 7-year-old boy with round childlike face proportions, messy dark brown hair, large soft eyes, blue-gray tunic with a small three-leaf crest, understated medieval-fantasy clothing. No tears, no exaggerated tragedy. Use Image 2 only as background space reference: rustic wooden dining hall with table, soup bowls, bread, fireplace, south wall with a small blurred oval portrait, warm restrained indoor light.

Purpose/mood: after the brothers’ laughter stops, the warmth of the meal quietly leads into the mother’s blurred portrait, creating Theo’s understated first awareness of a new family and an empty place within that warmth. Quiet breath, restrained emotion.

Composition/camera: medium close-up, over-shoulder angle, portrait-lens feel. Camera begins above the bowl on the dining table and gently pushes in over Theo’s shoulder toward the wall portrait. Focus transitions from traces of fading laughter to Theo’s quiet gaze. Screen direction left to right.

Panel 1 full-width: close view of the dining table after laughter has just faded. Show the soup bowl surface with tiny ripples, bread nearby, and the stilling motion of Kyle’s blue sleeve cuff at edge of frame. Warm wood, low contrast blue-grays. The atmosphere becomes quiet. No faces needed here, just the meal and sleeve implying the family settling. Emphasize delicate linework on the small ripples in the broth.

Panel 2 full-width: Theo sits at the table in the left area, midground, seen partly from over shoulder / side profile. He slowly lifts only his head toward the south wall. His spoon pauses in his hand. Expression: quiet thought left behind after a smile, subtle and understated. Gaze fixed on the small blurred oval portrait on the wall to the right side, kept small in frame. Include table warmth in foreground, Theo’s side profile in middle layer, and the tiny indistinct portrait and wooden wall in background. The oval portrait must remain intentionally unidentifiable, softly blurred so no concrete facial features are readable. Suggest a faint awareness of wind outside the dining room through atmosphere only, not dramatic.

Visual treatment: soft 2D webtoon coloring, warm wood and muted blue-gray low contrast palette. Fine emphasis only on bowl ripples and Theo’s eye line. Lighting warm but restrained. No melodrama.

Avoid: speech bubbles, captions, readable text, watermark, signature, duplicate character, any clear mother’s face, tears, melodrama.
